description: APEX AI Assistant MVP — Automation, Web Agent, Memory, Vision and Task Planning modules

userStories.title: Add TaskStep and TaskPlan data models to interfaces
userStories.description: As a developer, I need data models for multi-step task planning so that the TaskPlanner can decompose goals into executable steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TaskStep dataclass to core/interfaces.py with fields: id, description, plugin_name, params, status (pending/running/done/failed), result
Add TaskPlan dataclass with fields: goal, steps (List[TaskStep]), current_step_index, status
Add TaskPlannerBase abstract class with method: plan(goal: str) -> TaskPlan
Existing interfaces remain unchanged and backward-compatible
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add MemoryEntry data model and MemoryStore interface
userStories.description: As a developer, I need memory abstractions so that short-term and long-term memory modules have a shared contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add MemoryEntry dataclass to core/interfaces.py with fields: id, content, metadata (dict), timestamp, entry_type (session/persistent)
Add MemoryStore abstract class with methods: store(entry), query(text, k) -> List[MemoryEntry], clear()
Existing interfaces remain unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create ShortTermMemory module
userStories.description: As a user, I want the assistant to remember context from the current session so it can reference earlier commands and responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Create core/memory/__init__.py and core/memory/short_term.py
ShortTermMemory implements MemoryStore using an in-memory list with max_entries config (default 50)
query() searches content via substring/keyword match and returns top-k results
clear() resets the session memory
Unit test in tests/test_short_term_memory.py passes with store/query/clear scenarios
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

Uses ChromaDB with persistent storage at data/memory/ directory
store() adds entry with embedding via ChromaDB default embedding function

userStories.title: Register memory services in Kernel
userStories.description: As a developer, I need memory available as kernel services so all modules can store and retrieve context.

Both registered via register_service('short_memory', ...) and register_service('long_memory', ...)
Add memory config section to config/config.yaml with max_entries and persist_path

userStories.title: Implement TaskPlanner using Gemini LLM
userStories.description: As a user, I want the assistant to decompose complex goals into a sequence of executable steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Create core/task_planner.py implementing TaskPlannerBase
Uses GeminiClient to generate a plan from a goal string
Prompt includes list of available plugin names and their capabilities
Returns a TaskPlan with ordered TaskSteps, each referencing a plugin_name and params
Handles LLM errors gracefully with logging
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add multi-step task execution loop to Kernel
userStories.description: As a user, I want the assistant to execute multi-step plans sequentially, handling failures at each step.
acceptanceCriteria: Add execute_plan(plan: TaskPlan) method to Kernel
Iterates through steps in order, calling dispatch or plugin.execute for each
Updates step.status to running/done/failed as execution progresses
Stores intermediate results in ShortTermMemory
On step failure: logs error, marks plan as failed, returns partial results
Emits events: plan_started, step_started, step_completed, step_failed, plan_completed
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create AutomationPlugin for mouse and keyboard control

userStories.title: Add autonomy modes to SecurityManager
userStories.description: As a user, I want to control the assistant's autonomy level so I can choose between manual confirmation, semi-autonomous, and fully autonomous execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Add AutonomyMode enum to core/security.py: MANUAL, SEMI_AUTO, AUTONOMOUS
Add autonomy_mode field to SecurityManager, configurable via config.yaml
MANUAL: all actions require confirmation (current behavior)
SEMI_AUTO: whitelisted actions auto-execute, others require confirmation
AUTONOMOUS: all non-dangerous actions auto-execute (dangerous always blocked)
Add set_autonomy_mode() and get_autonomy_mode() methods
Update can_execute_shell() to respect autonomy mode
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
